easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show an exhibition floor plan where eight lettered stands are auto-placed in a 6-column grid? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_form: Does this image show, on an otherwise plain white page, one single rectangular coloured board that holds several flat solid-coloured rectangular panels of different widths? Answer yes or no only.
reference.q_colors: The grid has 3 rows of 6 equal cells. Name the colour showing in each of the 18 cells in reading order: top row left to right, then the next row. A wide panel counts once for every cell it covers. Use one word per cell: red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple. Answer with the 18 colour words separated by commas and nothing else.
reference.q_probe: A thick WHITE rectangle has been drawn on top of exactly one cell of the grid. What colour is showing around and inside that white rectangle -- the colour of the panel covering that cell, or the container's own background colour if no panel covers it? Answer with exactly one word from this list: red, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple.
reference.q_count: Ignoring the panels' widths, how many equal cells wide is the grid? Answer with a whole number only.
